notes: Printed: 'your first instant or sorcery spell each turn': one count over both kinds. A sorcery (Crash Through: draw a card) is cast first and is copied (two draws: the hand goes 2 -> 1 -> 3); the instant cast after it (Shock at the opponent) is the SECOND instant or sorcery of the turn, not the first instant: it is not copied (no new-target ask: the step has no word left), so the opponent takes 2 once (18).
